# Perfuncted v1.3.1

- **KDE Wayland windows:** Added KWin-native active-window details, compositor cursor-position queries, fullscreen, keep-above/keep-below, and titlebar shading commands.
- **Virtual desktops:** Added `pf desktop list`, `pf desktop switch`, and `pf window set-desktop`.
- **Native tiling:** Added `pf window tile` and `pf window float`, with compositor state verification.
- **Pointer automation:** Added `pf input move-relative` with coordinate-space validation and compositor cursor-position readback.
- **Flatpak:** Updated Go SDK compatibility and sandbox permissions.
- **CI:** Added real KDE Wayland acceptance tests to stable release builds.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nskaggs/perfuncted/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
